handoff_payload.answer_text: Gross margin is not a useful metric for American Express because it is a financial-services company whose economics are driven by interest income/expense, credit-loss provisions, and operating expenses rather than a conventional cost of goods sold. In FY2022, revenue net of interest expense grew 24.7%, but higher interest expense (+115.4% versus +40.1% interest-income growth) and a USD 3,601 million increase in provisions for credit losses reduced growth after provisions to 15.7%; major operating-cost increases included USD 6,176 million in discount revenue and USD 2,995 million in card-member rewards.
